prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: mut-bigN-15
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): 5a59db1d00bf7162
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Loopback send 0xa5 never completes: recv_buf_valid stays 0 instead of 1, causing uart timeout with no byte received. In recv_state 10 completion the code assigns recv_buf_valid <= 2 which truncates to 0 for a 1-bit valid flag. Thus recv_buf_data is captured from recv_pattern but never marked valid.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash 5a59db1d00bf7162 in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
